review:
San Quentin Manhunt is a scatter-pays prison slot on a 1-3-5-5-3-1 diamond grid. Seven or more matching symbols win and drop away, and every position has its own Multiplier Block, which grows each time that position is part of a win.

Enhancer Cells above and below each reel spin independently. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 46,532x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
